title: What is Harness Engineering
description:
If you're using Al in your business but not measuring it.. you're just guessing.

That's where Harness Engineering comes in.
Think TEST:
﻿﻿T- Test cases: real scenarios your business actually runs
﻿﻿E - Evaluate output: is it accurate, clear, on-brand?
﻿﻿S-Score performance: put numbers to quality
﻿﻿T - Tune systems: improve prompts, workflows, models

In this example, a marketing agency turns Al from "hit or miss" → into something consistent, measurable, and scalable.

Stop hoping your Al works. Start testing it. #ai #businessgrowth #aitips #aiforbusiness
